terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.draft: Version: draft (to be reviewed by legal before the official terms go live)
terms.s1p: Wishly is a platform for creating wishlists, sharing links, and letting friends and family pledge items. The actual purchase, shipping and handover between the giver and the list owner are handled by the two of them; the platform does not handle goods or payments.
terms.s2l1: Do not post content that is fraudulent, inappropriate, infringing, or that exposes other people's personal data.
terms.s2l2: Do not use automation to pledge in bulk or disrupt the service.
terms.s2l3: If you find content that breaks the rules, use "Report this list" at the bottom of the list page. After manual review it may be taken down.
terms.s3p: Browsing a shared link does not require registration, but pledging requires signing in. One person can have only one active pledge per item, and can change the quantity or cancel at any time; a pledge that has been delivered can't be cancelled.
terms.s4p: The service is provided as is, and we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. The platform is not liable for disputes arising from list content, third-party product links or transactions between the parties, but will cooperate in handling content that breaks the rules.
terms.s5p: Changes to the terms are posted on this page. Continuing to use the service means you agree to them.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draft: Version: draft (to be reviewed by legal before the official version goes live)
privacy.collectH: Notice on personal data collection (when pledging)
privacy.c1: What we collect: nickname (required), contact info (optional), email (optional), message (optional).
privacy.c2: Purpose: so the list owner knows who pledged which items and can contact you; your email is used to send the pledge confirmation and the "Manage my pledges" link.
privacy.c3: Who sees it: your nickname and contact info are visible only to the list owner; your email is never shown to other visitors or to the owner. If the owner turns on "Show givers" and it is not during a surprise lock, other visitors can see your nickname.
privacy.c4: Leaving these blank does not stop you from pledging, but you need to leave an email to recover your pledges after switching phones.
privacy.deviceP: To recognize you in "My pledges", we store a random identifier (localStorage and cookie) and the nickname you last used in your browser. LINE's built-in browser may clear this data, so we recommend opening the site in your default browser.
privacy.rightsP: You can change your nickname in "My pledges", or choose "Delete my nickname and contact info": we clear your nickname, contact info and email, and keep the pledge record as "Deleted guest" so the list owner can reconcile. Emails have a one-click unsubscribe link in the footer.
privacy.reportP: Reports are reviewed manually and the list owner is not told who reported. To prevent abuse we use Cloudflare Turnstile and rate-limit by IP.
privacy.loginP: To prevent brute-force attacks, when a sign-in fails we record the email and IP address used. This is used for temporary lockouts and human verification, and in aggregate for operational monitoring; records are deleted automatically after 365 days.
